executions.command: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && python check.py
executions.outcome: 808/808 assertions preserved (output isomorphic to input); 7/7 valid examples conform to gufoshapes; invalid examples 1 and 7 give exactly 2 and 5 violations, matching the recorded oracles
limitations: No OWL 2 DL reasoning (recorded run used Pellet).
Checks the published OntoGraph outputs; does not run the OntoGraph runtime, which is not publicly distributed.

executions.outcome: 7/7 valid examples: no UFO-rule findings, gufoshapes conform in pySHACL and Jena 6.2.0, Pellet consistent; invalid-01: 2 rule findings and 2 gufoshapes violations; invalid-07: 1 rule finding and 6 gufoshapes violations; 0 unclassified differences; Jena agreed with pySHACL on all nine cases.
limitations: This is a retained OntoGraph run. Regenerating the outputs needs the OntoGraph runtime, which is not public.
The portable bundle checks published outputs against gufoshapes. It does not rerun OntoGraph, Jena or Pellet.
No independent human ontologist has reviewed the models or these results.
No parity is claimed with the official OntoUML validator, the OntoUML server, or the Visual Paradigm plugin.
